example_sentences_in_bangla: সে দিগগজের মতো সবকিছু ভুলে যায়।
এই দিগগজ পণ্ডিতের কথা কেউ শোনে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He forgets everything like a directional elephant.
No one listens to this fool pretending to be wise.
history: Refers to the eight mythical elephants (Diggaj) in Hindu cosmology that guard the eight directions of the universe, with Airavata being the chief elephant of Indra.
note: Often used to mock someone with superficial knowledge or great stupidity despite appearances of wisdom.
